phase_prompt.summary: Mighbari in his standard guardian stance, holding the Obsidian Codex.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Mighbari, the Guardian of the Solar Obelisk, stands in a poised stance, his obsidian‑etched basalt armor shimmering with copper filigree and crystalline lattices that glow with bioluminescent glyphs. His jade mask features a glowing scarab‑eye sensor, while his hands cradle the Obsidian Codex projecting holographic script and a Solar Scepter channeling light, rendered in photorealistic, tactile detail with ancient Ethiopian‑Egyptian mysticism.
